title: Anyone use Astra with Godot? Is it capable of using it?
author: MHZ-Dev
selftext: Interested to know.. have my project gunshore I want to jump back into one day

comments.author: RUSuper
comments.body: I’m using it with Godot. More than capable, especially in terms of graphics, it really is good. But token consumption… yeah get ready for a world of pain

replies.author: MHZ-Dev
replies.body: Sounds promising. I've only ever used the desktop app chat interface when I used it last but this was GPT3 days. I eventually transitioned to Claude and only use GPT for brainstorming ideas. Are you using codex?

replies.author: RUSuper
replies.body: I use Claude and Codex for making my game - yes. Astra significantly improved looks of my game I must admit while Fable is still in charge of in game systems and logic.

replies.author: MHZ-Dev
replies.body: Great I'm going to check it out thank you!

replies.author: AlgaeNo3373
replies.body: Echoing what RUSuper said. Same setup for me.

replies.author: Rude_Arugula_1872
replies.body: Any more tips? Godot through mcp? Web or self contained/appstore games?

replies.author: RUSuper
replies.body: I use it both ways, with and without MCP. No web, who the fuck makes games serious games in web

replies.author: Rude_Arugula_1872
replies.body: What does it use for glb/3d models?

replies.author: RUSuper
replies.body: What do you mean? Blender with MCP

replies.author: Rude_Arugula_1872
replies.body:
You don't need to be so condescending in every answer.

Don't assume everyone has your collective hivemind.

replies.author: RUSuper
replies.body: I don’t assume anything, I asked you what do you mean

replies.author: MHZ-Dev
replies.body: Do you think it would be best to zip the whole project and just hand it over for the llm to understand it all? As there is tons that links together. This is my project : https://pixelharris.itch.io/gunshore

replies.author: RUSuper
replies.body: No, give it access to project via Visual Studio or desktop app, reading through project is not the way anyone does it I don't think.

replies.author: MHZ-Dev
replies.body: Ah yeah didn't think of that. Thank you

comments.author: Destituted
comments.body: Get a free context7 API key, add the Godot-ai MCP plug-in, hook codex up to them both, and go wild.  It’s really really good.
